description: The stock-by-location table component rendered against the real GET /api/stock shows separate stock-col-batch and stock-col-serial headers and per-row stock-batch-<sku>-<loc> / stock-serial-<sku>-<loc> cells holding the record's batch and serial, with no combined tracking-code column

The stock-by-location table component rendered against a real nonconforming-code row (per-run-unique randomUUID sku) shows a not-tracked cell (stock-batch-not-tracked-<sku>-<loc> / stock-serial-not-tracked-<sku>-<loc>, class not-tracked) reading 'not tracked' for each empty field, never blank
The stock-table component rendered against a real row with NULL batch and populated serial shows 'not tracked' in the batch cell while the serial cell still shows its value (NFR7 client render)

The SKU detail component rendered against the real GET /api/skus/{sku} shows, inside each sku-location-<loc> position, separately labelled sku-batch-<loc> and sku-serial-<loc> fields with that record's values

The SKU detail component rendered against a real position with empty batch/serial shows sku-batch-not-tracked-<loc> and sku-serial-not-tracked-<loc> (class not-tracked) reading 'not tracked', never blank
